sources.name: LiveBench 2.0 Global
sources.notes: New LiveBench 2.0 board, kept separate from historical LiveBench v1 2026-06-25. All 36 raw rows inspected; 19 exact roster models retained. Publisher current JavaScript maps internal dataset ID 2026-09-02 to displayed release 2026-10-13 and explicitly declares last updated 13 October 2026. Each suite is one run per model. Global is the equal-weight mean of the seven available suites, calculated from raw CSV before two-decimal display rounding; Coding and Long-Horizon are distinct suites. The publisher labels Long-Horizon as Agentic. Effort is explicit per-model publisher metadata, not inferred from generic highest-effort prose; reasoner=true is recorded as thinking. Harness and fallback policies are unreported. Undated Qwen3.8 Max omitted because metadata does not establish required 0902 checkpoint. Muse Wonder 1.0 matches released Muse Wonder, not Muse Wonder Full. No vendor launch numbers used.

sources.notes: Raw owner client CSV from https://andonlabs.com/evals/blueprint-bench-2 fetched October13; no board update timestamp, updated is fetch date. Reproduce the exact client formula max(0,(rawScore-0.539)/(1-0.539)); score is not a percent. Every available exact roster row retained; no effort/mode is declared so these stay unspecified. Generic Gemini3.1Pro has no preview checkpoint identifier and is omitted conservatively. Values below random baseline are clamped by the board, not fabricated.
